title: Persian Breakfast Flatbread with Yogurt, Feta & Fresh Herbs

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice the tomatoes; transfer to a plate.
Peel cucumber, then trim off and discard the ends. Medium dice the cucumber and add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the parsley.
Working in batches if necessary, add the flatbreads to the hot grill pan and cook, turning halfway through, until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes per flatbread.
Add garlic and yogurt to a medium bowl and stir to combine. Spoon garlicky yogurt over the warm flatbreads.
Top the flatbread with tomato, cucumber, feta, herbs, and a drizzle of oil and season with salt and pepper.
Slice the flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
